mechanism: Train a small balanced kernel regression classifier from reference foreground/background mode anchors and apply it to every query token. The degree-two feature map retains both signed first-order information and pairwise feature products. It compares individual token features, not covariance of complete query components.
inputs: existing MEAN field64 for shared control and abstention fallback only
data_exposure: Only the supplied reference mask provides training labels. No query GT, class/fold input, additional reference image or encoder forward is used. This is per-reference fitting with compressed anchors, not independent calibration or a calibrated semantic probability.
steps: Require at least8 pure foreground and8 pure background tokens, using coverage>=0.9 and1-coverage>=0.9. Missing class samples preserve the original base exactly.

Compress each class to at most16 deterministic spherical modes with5 Lloyd iterations, weighted by reference coverage or its complement. Class weights sum to0.5 each; within each class use the observed mode masses.
For unit anchors define k(x,a)=((1+cos(x,a))/2)^2, whose self-kernel is1. Explicit features are[1,sqrt(2)*x,vec(x*x^T)]/2, so the kernel is positive semidefinite and retains orientation information.

Use anchor targets y=+1 for foreground and-1 for background. Minimize sum_j w_j*(g(a_j)-y_j)^2+0.01*norm_H(g)^2. Solve the at-most32-dimensional positive-definite system (K+0.01*diag(1/w))*alpha=y, recording the relative residual and minimum regularized eigenvalue.
Compute the complete query score g(x)=sum_j alpha_j*k(x,a_j), map to clip(0.5+0.5*g,0,1), bilinear upsample to1024 and threshold>0.5. The active branch does not use or blend the base.

Save controls on the same anchor bank and readout: linear-kernel ridge with the same class weights and ridge; homogeneous squared-cosine ridge; weighted class mean of the final kernel; best foreground minus best background cosine; foreground versus background subspace projection energy, using SVD relative rank cutoff1e-6.
Use the shared CPU backend, keeping controls as controls and sealing all predictions before separate query-GT scoring.

construction_revision.observation: The initially considered homogeneous kernel cos(x,a)^2 aliases x and-x. A complete antipodal foreground/background fixture gives identical class scores and cannot segment the designated target.
construction_revision.repair: Before freezing this card, retain the linear and constant terms through the nonhomogeneous degree-two kernel. Normalize its self-kernel to1 so the nominal ridge has the same kernel scale as the linear and homogeneous controls.
construction_revision.record: quadratic_check.json retains the failed homogeneous construction as an ablation. The revision is not an additional method, and no real-data parameter search was performed.

prediction.conditional: When reference class separation requires nonlinear combinations of multiple modes and transfers to the query, a learned quadratic score can recover evidence lost by centroids or a single best match. It does not guarantee same-class identity or object completeness.
exact_properties: The explicit-feature primal and the kernel solve describe the same weighted ridge objective
Positive regularization and mode weights make the coefficient system positive definite even when anchor kernels are singular
The token binary gate is g(x)>0; this is not the gate of the final bilinear1024 mask at every subpixel
Common orthogonal feature transformations preserve the cosine kernels in exact arithmetic
An active classifier depends on query/reference features and reference labels, not on the supplied base

checks.optimization: quadratic_check.json:24 small problems compare the compressed kernel solution with independent ridge regression in explicit polynomial features; maximum score difference below4e-15. Positive regularized eigenvalues and small linear-system residuals checked.
checks.complete_first_contrast: Default complete token output retains64 designated target cells although each target's best foreground cosine0.55 is smaller than its best background cosine about0.628. Linear, nearest and kernel-mean controls miss them. Subspace projection also solves this example, so it does not establish a unique benefit of the kernel learner.
checks.polarity: The final kernel separates antipodal foreground/background features; the homogeneous construction cannot. Nearest matching also solves this polarity contrast.
checks.negative: When designated true query features shift toward reference background, the final classifier deletes all64 targets retained by a strong base. This complete-output failure remains recorded.
checks.cost: Dense synthetic4096x1024 inputs exercise16 foreground plus16 background anchors, including all five controls. Timing excludes common MEAN, I/O,1024 readout and cohort scoring.
checks.batch: runner_check.json checks active fitting with two CPU workers, unread query-GT sentinels, packed1024 controls and sealed predictions.

counterexamples: Query appearance can move toward reference background and erase an otherwise correct base; the64-token shifted-appearance fixture demonstrates this.
Single-reference background modes can overlap the true class elsewhere, and missing pure background samples force abstention.
Compressing each class to16 modes can omit rare parts, while spherical means can distort within-mode variation.
The classifier is pointwise and supplies no object-level connectivity, geometry or repeated-instance evidence; background with foreground-like features can be added.
Balanced source class weights and a fixed ridge are not calibrated to query prevalence or density. A signed regression score can overfit source anchors.
A simpler subspace or nearest rule can account for gains in different regimes. Real complete-mask improvements must beat the declared simple controls.

cpu_cost.bound: Reference compression O(T*N*K*D), T=5 and at most16 modes per class; anchor kernels and solves O(K_total^2*D+K_total^3), K_total<=32; query projections O(N*K_total*D). Storage O(ND+N*K_total+K_total^2). No extra encoder or feature-graph solve for the active candidate.
cpu_cost.synthetic_benchmark: quadratic_check.json includes the full32-anchor dense timing path and solver receipts; it is not an actual cohort runtime.
